snippet.title: NARON – Official Teaser Trailer | Co-op Mining Roguelite (1–4 Players)
snippet.description:
NARON is a co-op mining roguelite for 1–4 players. Twenty depths into a dying moon.
▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4828260/Naron/

Your drillship descends twenty depths into a dying moon. Every depth sets a
task, every task wakes something, and the way back gets more expensive the
closer you get to the core. 47 crews tried. No crew came back.

▶ Discord (the crew hangs out here): https://discord.gg/kKeEK3AUBh

── What you actually do down there ──
• Ramp down into freshly generated caves, clear the depth's main objective,
  grab what you can, get back and seal the hatch
• Fully deformable rock across six biomes: caverns, mushroom caves, flooded
  chambers, lava halls, ice fields, crystal caves
• A branching route tree — you see two depths ahead, the crew votes on the way down
• 10 main objectives, 18 side contracts, 2 boss encounters in rotation
• Pressure fronts, toxic gas, lava, oxygen limits. The moon isn't fighting you.
  It's just collapsing.
• Proximity voice chat and radio, so the crew can actually lose each other
• A drillship workshop between descents — heavy gear (jetpack, gas mask, shield)
  has to be salvaged from the camps of crews that didn't make it
• 28 permanent upgrades bought with NARON Points
• Online co-op 1–4, fully playable solo, session saves to continue a run later

── Facts ──
Playable demo: Steam Next Fest, October 2026
Release: 2027 · PC (Windows) · English & German
Developer: TIDERAFT
